plugins.name: zcode-statusline
plugins.description: Toolbar-style usage footer for ZCode: appends a one-line status bar (turns, steps, tok/s, session tokens, cache-hit rate) to the end of every reply, computed from the real ZCode usage database.

description_i18n.zh-CN: 每条回复末尾附一行真实用量状态栏(轮数/步数/tok/s/会话 token 总量/缓存命中率),数据取自 ZCode usage 数据库。
